findings.title: Coil-Floor Absorption
findings.definition: Z-absorption {Z1,Z1G,Z2,Z2G,Z5,Z10,Z11} at the floor (<=6% off 25b-low) of a held compressed base (25b range<=35%) + rs_intact + rsi<40

findings.title: QZ-Capit-Reversal
findings.definition: $21-89 oversold pullback to a fresh 15d-low + 1H capitulation + reversal-cluster

findings.title: T1 Capitulation-Bounce (GEM1)
findings.definition: small T1 (body<0.5x prior-Z) after a Z, RSI30-50, vol=B — most robust edge

findings.title: Cluster-Bottom (confluence)
findings.definition: >=N distinct edge-FAMILIES in a 10-bar window; monotone with count; buy LOW of the box

findings.title: Z-Absorb-Turn
findings.definition: deep-bear Z5/Z11 + wt_evr + red-L34 -> next-bar T3/T9 confirm; 1D-native

findings.title: D+L1 bear-trap reversal
findings.definition: D breakdown + L1 absorption -> reversal; only setup to survive 2022

findings.title: Engulf-Absorb-Reversal
findings.definition: T4/T6 + 15m Z-DOMINANT (T/(Z+T)<0.5) + rs_intact + rsi<60 + prior10d<+8% + $21-89. Counter-intuitive: intraday absorption (not clean demand) marks the reversal-engulf. 100% orthogonal to coilfloor/engulfabs/capit.

findings.title: Bottom-Anatomy detector (nested 1D->1H->15m)
findings.definition: 3 axes: location (held/tested floor) + absorption (multi-TF Z) + internal-reversal. Verdicts: rev (structural low), rev+RS (durable), shake (spring: weak-close + late hi-vol T-reversal, intraday-only tell), cont (markup).

stats.note: necessary-not-sufficient; score does NOT rank precision; RS separates tradeable not detectable

findings.title: STATE + STRUCTURE > SHAPE + timing
findings.definition: The tradeable edge lives in market STATE (oversold, RS, absorption) + STRUCTURE (held floor), NOT in bar/signal SHAPE or intraday timing. Confirmed across 3 TFs.

findings.title: Fade strength, buy absorbed weakness
findings.definition: High-volume green momentum (T12, clean-demand) = distribution, NOT bottom. Absorbed weakness (Z-codes on volume at a held floor) = the real bottom. Even engulfs (T4/T6) want intraday Z-dominance, not clean demand.

findings.title: Buy the LOW of the box, not the breakout
findings.definition: Floor-entry >> breakout-entry (mean +1.70 vs +0.45). Deep-shakeout base HURTS (base must HOLD). Breakout = edge mostly gone (median-neg, tail-only).

findings.title: Intraday echo adds no tradeable edge (except the shakeout)
findings.definition: 1H/15m echo (T12, Z-abs, T-ratio) is REDUNDANT to daily coil-floor (+2.69 vs +2.65). Intraday helps ONLY where the daily bar HIDES the pattern (weak-close shakeout: base -1.57 -> +1H-tell -0.48). Otherwise daily state decides.

findings.title: RS = tradeability discriminator, not detection
findings.definition: rs = close/benchmark > EMA200(rs). Does NOT improve bottom DETECTION (32% vs 33% precision) but IS the tradeability gate: RS-intact bottoms are the durable payers (path-sim +2.69/5yr); RS-negative = knife (median-neg). Worst-year rescuer.

findings.title: Quality zone $21-89
findings.definition: Segment every edge by price. Real edge lives $21-89 (win 59-62%, cat~1%). <$8 = lottery (high mean illusion, median neg). Pooling inflates via cheap-stock tail.

findings.title: Extended engulf = AVOID (both directions)
findings.definition: T4/T6 with RSI>72 + prior-10d>+15% = catastrophic long (-6..-9, win 35-39, 2022 -15). And NOT a short either: short loses -5.44 (worse than random, whipsaw). It is a high-variance AVOID zone, not a signal. Extension is the ONE robust T4/T6 discriminator.

findings.title: Dec-Mar season suppressor
findings.definition: Dec-Mar kills ALL 14 setups (median -2..-8, 5-6/6yr incl bull years). Apr-Jun + Sep-Nov = 14/14 positive. Only Z11+GEM1 bad-tolerant.

findings.title: Sub-200 bear-rally suppressor
findings.definition: 1D close<EMA200 with e9>e20>e50 (bear-market rally) hurts EVERY setup (delta -1..-3.3, era-indep).

findings.title: Vol-adjacency / vol-extreme veto
findings.definition: bias_dn / vol-extreme are universal suppressors (kill ALL setups, 6/6yr negative). Confluence law: vol-adjacency veto.

findings.title: L-line levels are not key-levels
findings.definition: T*L46/T*L34 (green OR red/Z) as price levels hold ~54% = RANDOM. Signal identity of the bar that printed a level is noise; repeated-tested-and-held floor is the real key-level.

findings.title: T2-T2 intraday combo does not help T6
findings.definition: T6 with consecutive T2-T2 on 1H or 15m = same/worse than T6 all (-2.55 vs -2.35). Refuted.

findings.title: Engulf swallowing an EMA does not help
findings.definition: T4/T6 that swallows/reclaims EMA20/50/89/200 = ~random (all -2.4..-2.6). Reclaiming a key MA sounds strong but is statistically flat.

findings.title: Clean-demand intraday does NOT mark a good engulf
findings.definition: The AMD/IONQ 3-chart pattern (15m T-ratio>0.65 = strong) is refuted universe-wide: clean-demand (T-dominant) engulfs are WORSE (-3.0) than Z-dominant (-1.4). Survivorship of 3 examples.

findings.title: RSI-50 cross is not an edge
findings.definition: RSI(14) crossing 50 up (any variant) = no edge; 10D spike ratio ~0.95/win50% every year.

findings.title: L43-TRIPLE
findings.definition: L43 VSA-body + reversal-T + gap-sweet; most-validated (MC P>0=100%, ablation, plateau)

findings.title: Z11-T11
findings.definition: Z11 oversold anchor → T11 confirm; DSR selection-proof

findings.title: G3 gap reclaim
findings.definition: Large gap-up on oversold (RSI<45) + T + non-VB, ANY L; L5 sharpest

findings.title: Atomic bull
findings.definition: bull-T close=open + gap + vol=B; real & time-stable; $21-89 quality

findings.title: ⚡G3-Abs
findings.definition: same-bar G3 ∧ Atomic-absorption

findings.title: Engulf-Absorption
findings.definition: bull-T RANGE-engulfs prior 2 bars ≥$21 + RSI<45 swallowing a fresh Edge signal; RANGE≫body

findings.title: Engulf-L46 (GEM2)
findings.definition: engulf-absorption on L46 volume-line

findings.title: Washout reversal
findings.definition: quality (beta 0.6-1.5, NOT high-beta) oversold in VIX-spike panic; 2022-survivor

findings.title: 1H-confirmed bottom
findings.definition: 1D deep-oversold + 1H VX-climax → R2X reclaim; flips the knife

findings.title: RTB-Base
findings.definition: RTB phase A/B build/turn + RSI<35 (RTB total/phase ranks BACKWARDS — only this slice works)

findings.title: HighBase-15m-Dip
findings.definition: held high base: e200↑ · RSI1d 40-60 · ≤15% off 20d-high · green · min 15m-RSI≤28

findings.title: G3→G3→RL chain
findings.definition: two G3 gaps then reclaim-line; strongest gap-chain, plateau-proven

findings.title: G3+RL
findings.definition: G3 gap + reclaim-line

findings.title: Zone-Retest + EDGE-absorb
findings.definition: 2nd+ touch of 25-bar support that HOLDS (not first knife) WITH an edge-absorption bar

findings.title: Wyckoff Spring
findings.definition: buy the SHAKEOUT not breakout: w2_spring + RSI35-45 + T + non-VB (base median-neg; 🔑/🌀SC/🏆RS variants elite)

findings.title: P55 refined long
findings.definition: 1D+1H P55 exact + absorption-T + non-VB + Z1G/T5 prelude + P→D→P + shallow shakeout

findings.title: P parabola ride
findings.definition: any-P + accumulation fingerprint + 25% TRAILING stop; trend-follow, edge-in-tail

findings.title: Zone-Retest (base)
findings.definition: buy 2nd+ touch of 25-bar support that holds; modest median, edge excludes the knife

findings.title: T6 @ Wyckoff SC-floor
findings.definition: T6 at Wyckoff SC floor (±5% support) + RSI<40 — the ONE tradeable T4/T6 edge (T4=2025 artifact)

findings.title: 🏆 RS gate — worst-year rescuer
findings.definition: rs=close/benchmark > EMA200(rs) = quality-dip vs structural-knife. UNIVERSAL worst-year rescuer: makes Cluster/QZ-Capit/G3-Abs/Washout/D+L1/Spring 2022-POSITIVE. Sector-ETF sharper than SPY.

findings.title: 🧱 OB gate — amplifier
findings.definition: order-block retest amplifies momentum edges: G3→G3→RL🧱OB +8.70→+21.4; RTB-Base/D+L1/Cluster/QZ-Capit gain.

findings.title: 🔑 Key-level gate
findings.definition: support tested ≥2× = real level not knife; sharpens LOCATION-reversal edges (Spring/QZ-Capit/D+L1). Deep-wick HURTS. Only helps location edges, not momentum.

findings.title: 🎋 TLS (trendline-support) gate
findings.definition: edge-specific: QZ-Capit🎋TLS +3.22/PF1.57 built; G3-Abs🎋TLS era-tilted=watch.

findings.title: ⚡ CHARGED energy state
findings.definition: pre-spike prep (AUC 0.63/6yr/3TF); energy NOT direction; boosts 9/10 setups (Z11 +14.6). Feeder, not timer.

findings.title: MTF confirmation layer
findings.definition: strongest VETO: 1D signal with ZERO 4H/1H/15M echo = negative (0/6yr); ≥1 confirm flips positive (5-6/6yr). 4H-trigger early entry +0.84pp. Flags the BASE not breakouts.

findings.title: Pullback entry timing
findings.definition: UNIVERSAL winner: enter on dip-and-reclaim not strength-chase (+0.7..+1.9pp/6yr matched). Chasing strength LOSES.

findings.title: 🎯 Confluence-cluster ladder
findings.definition: ≥N distinct edge-FAMILIES in 10-bar window = real bottom; ×3 +3.80 → ×6+ +12.93/med+9.58/win72. NOT an RSI proxy (4 STATE axes); survives 2022. Buy LOW of the box.

findings.title: Real edges echo across timeframes (fractal criterion)
findings.definition: A genuine edge repeats on other TFs; G3 4/5 TFs, Z11 3/4. GEM1 & Z-Absorb are strictly 1D-native (that's a property, not a flaw). Use echo as a reality-check on new edges.

findings.title: Absorbed effort = buy; unconfirmed confirmation = noise
findings.definition: Confluence law 1: high effort (volume) absorbed with no result → accumulation → buy. Law 3: paying for confirmation (breakout/BO/BX/BE arrows) costs edge — the move already happened.

findings.title: CONF beats every legacy momentum score
findings.definition: All-vs-all confluence score: conditional Spearman +0.13 (~5× ultra_v3), orthogonal to legacy (|ρ|<0.14). Legacy momentum scores are anti-predictive; use CONF/edges to rank, legacy only as context.

findings.title: Win% rises with price, catastrophe falls
findings.definition: Quality $21-89 win 59-62%/cat~1%; cheap <$8 = lottery (high MEAN illusion, median negative). Read win%/median/catastrophe BY PRICE bucket, never pooled mean.

findings.title: Single-name brilliance = survivorship, not edge
findings.definition: RKLB PB/BO, RSI-50 cross, P55 big-growth all looked great on one name, ≈coin-flip universe-wide. Auto-detection over the whole universe is the only honest test.

findings.title: Dec-Mar suppresses ALL setups
findings.definition: Dec-Mar kills all 14 setups (median −2..−8, even bull years); Apr-Jun + Sep-Nov 14/14 positive. Only Z11 & GEM1 tolerate the bad season.

findings.title: Cross-TF price-shape analog matching = no edge
findings.definition: IC≈0 / hit 50% OOS. SHAPE is noise; only purest STATE>SHAPE confirmation survives.

findings.title: EDGE ∩ robust-sequence = no edge (OOS)
findings.definition: Cross-confirming edge+seq good in-sample, FAILED walk-forward (circular). Don't build.

findings.title: L-cluster → big-move = no edge
findings.definition: L34/L22/L43/L64 clustering ≠ volatility/direction; coil MUTES moves (MFE 3.5 vs 6.3%).

findings.title: P50/P55/P66 EMA-cross alone = no long edge
findings.definition: Multi-TF confluence ≈0pp; VB volume = fade-trap (MFE-proxy illusion, neg 6/6yr).

findings.title: Counting swallowed candles = no edge
findings.definition: No edge any variant; RSI subsumes it. Hand-picked zones = selection bias, auto-detection exposed it.

findings.title: Path-sim, never MFE-proxy
findings.definition: True bar-by-bar path sim (stop-first), never MFE≥target proxy — proxy inflates hugely (EMA-breakout proxy +3.4 → path-sim −2.4). Every stat in this brain is path-sim.

findings.title: Always segment by price bucket
findings.definition: Test every edge in <8 / 8-21 / 21-89 / 89+ buckets; pooling inflates via the <$8 lottery. Real edge lives $21-89.

findings.title: BUY score: RSI dominates, legacy anti-predictive
findings.definition: Screener Score = RSI+volB backbone, 2-sided veto (RSI≥60 🔴EXT / <28 🔪KNIFE). Legacy momentum scores are anti-predictive; LOW momentum predicts better, HIGH = survivorship trap.

findings.title: ULTRA Score v3 = reweighted ranker
findings.definition: old ultra_score anti-predictive (Spearman −0.004); v3 drops dead breakouts + adds oversold/price-zone/RS/cluster/TLS → Spearman +0.078, Q5−Q1 med +6.74pp/6yr. Modest triage, use as SORT.

findings.definition: coil_floor ∧ ob_retest — auto-discovered combo (lift +5.11pp, DSR 1.0, train +9.03/verify +11.89)

findings.definition: gem1_capbounce ∧ m15_zdom — auto-discovered combo (lift +1.34pp, DSR 0.5797, train +9.79/verify +8.81)

findings.definition: engulf_absorb_rev ∧ wtevr — auto-discovered combo (lift +1.92pp, DSR 0.8217, train +6.67/verify +6.22)

findings.definition: g3g3rl ∧ m15_zdom — auto-discovered combo (lift +1.68pp, DSR 1.0, train +3.64/verify +8.36)

findings.definition: g3rl ∧ ob_retest — auto-discovered combo (lift +5.61pp, DSR 1.0, train +5.65/verify +11.97)

findings.title: T1-RS-Dip (quality-dip)
findings.definition: T1 demand bar · RSI<45 · RS-intact · close $21-89 — quality-dip in a strong name (raw T1 is era-dependent noise; RS+quality make it 5/5yr)

findings.title: T3-RS-Dip (quality-dip)
findings.definition: T3 continuation-demand · RSI<45 · RS-intact · $21-89 — 6/6yr all-positive, med+1.21, n3387, DSR1.0, plateau 5 buckets (PBO 0.54 near-dup artifact)

findings.title: 🏆 L34→L34 continuity
findings.definition: the SAME L34 VSA volume-line on BOTH the Z-absorption bar and the next-bar T1 demand bar. The CONTINUITY is the edge — L34 on the T1 bar alone is null (+0.59/med−0.91/4-6yr). Not RSI-subsumed (2021 flips −2.4→+2.6). L46/L25 never persist across Z→T1; L3→L3 fails.

findings.title: 🏆 L34→L34 + RS
findings.definition: L34→L34 continuity gated on RS-intact — the flagship variant

findings.title: 🎬 StopVol-Confirm
findings.definition: climax/stopping volume followed by a CONFIRMATION bar. The only pattern of 13 VSA-video patterns built raw with no priors that survived — 11/13 were coin-flips and the shorts lost. Confirmation + confluence is what survives, never the raw pattern.

findings.title: 🔁 Zone-Retest × GREEN-L46
findings.definition: Zone-Retest gated on the L46 volume-line. ZRT was our weakest big edge (4/6yr, worst −1.7) and RS is a TRAP on it; green-L46 is the right gate. +dwell tier is stronger still.

findings.title: ⚡ G3-Abs × 🕯️mid-close
findings.definition: G3-Abs whose close sits in the MIDDLE 38-62% of the bar's own range. The only G3-Abs gate that is 6/6yr with a positive worst year (🎋TLS 5/6 −1.9 · 🏆RS 4/5 −0.2) and it fires 3× as often as RS. Survives both price buckets, so uncapped.

findings.title: 🧩 L43-TRIPLE × 🕯️mid-close
findings.definition: L43-TRIPLE with a mid-range close, $21-89 only ($89-377 is 4/6yr worst −2.0). Best worst-year on the whole Replay board.

findings.title: 🌊 Washout × 💥 volume event
findings.definition: Washout requiring a real intraday volume event — separates a genuine climax from a slow drift down. The most dramatic single application of the intraday-volume gate.

findings.title: 💥 Intraday volume event (15m max/avg ≥4×)
findings.definition: THE most UNIVERSAL filter found. Unlike RS/dissonance (edge-specific) it improves EVERY edge tested, and its absence is a loss cell everywhere. Monotone ladder on raw L46: <2.5× med −5.85/pf0.90 → 2.5-4× −1.31 → 4-6× −0.10 → 6×+ +0.36. Reads: was there a REAL volume event inside the day?

findings.title: ⛔ No-volume-event veto (<2.5× intraday)
findings.definition: The severe cell (~3% of days): a flat session with no intraday volume event at all. L34 with it → pf 0.81, 3/6yr. Treat as a veto, not a weak signal.

findings.title: 🔵 Dwell (price hugging the level)
findings.definition: price within 3% of the 20-bar low on ≥5 of the last 10 bars = a genuinely REPEATED retest. IDENTICAL to the 'many prior touches' axis (91.3% overlap) — neither pays alone, only the intersection does, so they are one phenomenon measured two ways. Do not stack them.

findings.title: 🟢 Green-L46 gate
findings.definition: a GREEN L46 and a RED L46 are two different signals. Green-L46 rescued Zone-Retest from 4/6yr worst −1.7 to 6/6yr worst +0.6. Suppressors on green-L46: RSI>55, vol=VB, above-EMA200 — buying strength kills it, buying the beaten-down base works.

findings.title: 🔎 Intraday demand-line confirmation
findings.definition: no 15m L34 printed inside the session = validated loss cell on washout (1/6yr, med −5.28, pf 0.72), ZRT, atomic and D+L1 — but NOT on qzcapit (its no-L34 cell is BETTER) or coilfloor. Edge-specific.

findings.title: 🕯️ Mid-close gate (38-62% of range)
findings.definition: INVERTED-U: a STRONG close HURTS 6/8 edges (D+L1 −0.90, G3-Abs −0.48, Washout −0.40); the MIDDLE band pays. Wide plateau — every cut from 30-70 through 45-55 works. Reads as 'demand showed up but is not yet exhausted'. Edge-specific: G3-Abs/L43 carry it alone; on Washout/ZRT mid-close ALONE is a TRAP and only pays together with the volume event (those combined variants are DSR 0.54 = watch only).

findings.title: 🎲 Score-hits (ranker agreement)
findings.definition: how many of 6 rankers sit in THEIR OWN measured good zone — NOT 'high is good': ULTRA and BUY are inverted-U and high prebreak_v2 is the single worst cell in the system. Each component alone is near-worthless; the AGREEMENT carries. hits 0→5: −1.06/−0.67/+0.00/+1.05/+2.12/+3.79 monotone; ≥4 = 6/6yr with BOTH bear years positive. Zones picked on 2021-23 and the ladder HELD on 2024-26.

findings.title: Volume's sign is CONTEXT-DEPENDENT
findings.definition: On ABSORPTION/reversal bars (L46/L34) 1D volume is an inverted-U: 2-3× avg best, 3×+ worse (huge volume = climax = exhaustion). On BREAKOUT bars it INVERTS: 1.5-3× is the worst band and only 3×+ is positive (huge volume = real institutional participation). NEVER carry a volume threshold across bar contexts — re-measure it per setup type.

findings.title: A green L-line and a red L-line are different signals
findings.definition: Colour must be read with the VSA line, not averaged over it. Red-L34 is the absorption partner (Z-Absorb, L34→L34); GREEN-L46 is the Zone-Retest rescuer; green L34 on a REV flag is a trap. Whenever an L-line looks null, split it by colour before concluding.

findings.title: Retest is NOT direction-agnostic
findings.definition: The IDENTICAL formula pays on support-after-a-drop (+0.46/pf1.23; built tier 6/6yr) and LOSES on broken-resistance-after-a-breakout (−0.89/pf1.04; the '2nd entry' cell every breakout infographic pushes is −6.18/win40.6/pf0.97/3-6yr). So the edge was never 'retest' as geometry — it is BUYING ABSORBED WEAKNESS. An uptrend retest of broken resistance is strength-chasing in retest clothing.

findings.title: Best edges COMPRESS, they don't die — decay lives in COMBINATIONS
findings.definition: Excess-slope is now a standard metric. Raw signal alphabet is flat (all 29 TZ/L codes); the strongest edges compress over time (GEM1 +11.4→+4.7) rather than dying, and only Spring is rising (📈 emerging tier). The SHORT side is closed: 0/29 codes positive, Z-codes worst.

findings.title: Price↔time is governed by VOLATILITY, not by pattern geometry
findings.definition: days to ±X% ≈ k·(X/ATR%)^p, OOS-calibrated (GBM diffusion would predict p=2; empirics are far lower). Measure MAGNITUDE in ATR-units, not raw %. This is a TIMING tool, never a directional edge — and ATR%% is a per-NAME property, so it is useless as a per-BAR signal.

findings.title: Harmonic XABCD (Gartley/Bat/Alt-Bat) = no edge
findings.definition: Tested causally (D = the bar price reaches the projected zone, NOT a pivot — so no ZigZag lookahead). All patterns ≤ baseline; no plateau. THE CONTROL is decisive: same skeleton and same D-zone with the Fibonacci ratios REMOVED does BETTER (Gartley −0.57 vs −2.09 with ratios) — the ratios SUBTRACT. Price law inverted ($21-89 is the WORST bucket) = a reliable noise signature. NB Fibonacci works for us only as absolute DOLLAR zones, never as retracement ratios.

findings.title: Dan Zanger flag + volume breakout = no edge
findings.definition: Decomposed rather than tested whole: the tight-consolidation precondition SUBTRACTS (breakout without a coil beats the coiled one); 'wait for the breakout' is the worst of 3 entries (coil −0.38 · pullback −0.36 · breakout −0.70); his >50%-above-average volume is the WORST band; his <7% stop is the worst exit tested (pf 0.93/win 31%). Only 'biggest movers, avoid laggards' survives — and that is our RS gate. $10k→$42M is n=1 in the 1998-2000 tape.

findings.title: 'Strong breakout' close-position rule = no edge (raw)
findings.definition: Every 20d/50d breakout × close-position cell is negative and the 'STRONG' bucket (close ≥62% past the level) is WORSE than baseline. The colour rule runs BACKWARDS: green breakout −0.88 vs red −0.68, and the picture's best-rated cell (green + holds the level) is the worst at −1.04. The axis was still worth keeping — as a GATE it became gate_midclose.

findings.title: AM-GM / cup geometry (symmetry, measured move) = no edge
findings.definition: Symmetry ❌; measured-move projection ❌ (depth → med −9 trap, recovery time ≈ constant not geometric). ONLY rounded-vs-V survived, and that is dwell/absorption at the bottom = a coil-floor STATE, not a shape.

findings.title: L2 / L4 quiet-bar markers = no edge
findings.definition: Rare (L2 ≈1% of L12) but pf<1 and 64% carry vol=L; nothing rescues them. L2 is the daily analogue of the no-volume-event veto → context, never a signal.

findings.title: Measure risk-reward, not fixed horizons
findings.definition: 1d/5d/20d forward returns are the wrong success metric. Every trade now carries exp_r (mean ÷ planned risk), payoff (avg win ÷ avg loss), sortino, med_mae (heat taken) and med_mfe from the same path-sim.

findings.title: DSR ≥0.6 is the trust bar
findings.definition: Deflate every candidate against the FULL family of variants tried, including ones tried-and-discarded. Worked example: mid-close on G3-Abs 1.000 and L43 0.999 → BUILT; the same gate on Washout/ZRT came in at 0.541/0.537 → NOT built, despite a real-looking worst-year rescue. Legacy pre-path-sim numbers (e.g. 'VX-PS-R2X +7.87%/97.7%') are MFE-proxy artifacts — under path-sim it is −0.32 and the ordering against its supposed worst cell even INVERTS.

findings.title: Measure overlap BEFORE building
findings.definition: A new-looking gate is usually an old one from another angle. Touch-count vs dwell: 91.3% overlap and NEITHER pays alone → one phenomenon, and tightening would have made the served edge WORSE (worst-year +0.7 → +0.2). Same check turned 'green L46 + dwell' into a ZRT gate instead of a new setup (94% overlap).

findings.title: A single-axis null is not a combo null
findings.definition: Test the CONFLUENCE before declaring no-edge: MTF-EMA stacks, intraday echo and mid-close were all null standalone yet real as gates. Conversely test the components before believing a combo: decomposing Zanger/harmonics showed the distinctive part SUBTRACTS while the surviving part was already ours.

findings.title: Count occurrences before believing a 'formation'
findings.definition: A visually distinctive chart formation that occurs 100k+ times is not a formation. Eyes sample by OUTCOME — you notice the shape on charts where a move followed. Count first, then measure.

findings.title: Rank by trajectory, not only by level
findings.definition: Markets adapt, so a rare edge that still repeats is worth more than a common one fading. Excess-slope (edge minus baseline, per year) is now measured alongside median/PF so compression and emergence are visible rather than hidden inside a 6-year average.

findings.title: The smoother a trend LOOKS, the worse it pays — buy roughness
findings.definition: Hurst exponent of the trailing 60-bar path, measured 2026-07-30 on 2.7M bars, is MONOTONE and points the opposite way to intuition: H<0.35 +0.14 / 0.35-0.45 −0.31 / 0.45-0.55 −0.74 / 0.55-0.65 −0.93 / H>0.65 −2.37 (baseline −0.71, win 50.4%→44.8%, pf 1.24→0.90). Replicates on a 40-bar window. This is NOT volatility in disguise: corr(H, ATR%) = −0.008, and the H<0.45 vs H>0.55 spread holds INSIDE every ATR%% tercile (lo +0.92/+0.67, mid +0.47/−0.49, hi −5.51/−8.65). A persistent, low-noise, visually clean advance is where positioning is already crowded; a rough choppy path is where it is not. Practical rule: the chart you would screenshot as 'a beautiful trend' is the one to skip.

findings.title: If a pattern is in an infographic, assume it has no forward information
findings.definition: Six independent tests, six nulls: cross-TF fractal shape-matching (IC≈0, hit 50% OOS) · harmonic XABCD — Fib RATIOS actively SUBTRACT vs a control · cup/AM-GM symmetry and measured-move (depth→median −9) · Dan Zanger flag-breakout (coil subtracts, breakout worst of 3 entries, 1.5-2× volume the worst band) · the SETUP tokens A/SM/N/MX (0.04pp spread across four 'different' signals) · the RSI/CCI trendline break (+0.09pp over a FLAT line at the same pivot). Visual proof: deterministic Koch/Peano/Hilbert curve traversals — zero market content — produce waveforms indistinguishable from price charts, complete with double tops, channels and breakouts. If a Koch curve is indistinguishable from AAPL, 'it looks like X' carries no information. STATE > SHAPE, now 9 confirmations.
findings.source: project_fractal_matching_no_edge + harmonic + cup + zanger + setup tokens

findings.title: A number nobody measured is as likely to be backwards as forwards
findings.definition: Two independent cases, one week apart. CCI0R carried +5 (HARD_BEAR ×2) and +3 across three scoring engines: measured empty AND on the wrong side. BB↑ carried +15 in ultra_score — the LARGEST single bonus in the whole scheme — and measured −1.55 vs a −0.63 baseline, i.e. actively negative; SVS carried +8 and +5 and measured exactly nil. Both were inherited Pine heuristics that looked reasonable. Rule: treat every unmeasured weight as unsigned. Audit them by size — the biggest bonus on the least evidence is the first to check.

findings.title: High momentum scores are a survivorship trap; low scores predict better
findings.definition: Legacy momentum scores rank BACKWARDS (RTB phase/total anti-predictive; ultra_score and buy_score are inverted-U with their good zone in the MIDDLE; prebreak_v2/v3 anti-predictive). The 🎲 ensemble only works because each ranker is read in ITS OWN good zone rather than 'higher = better': 0→5 hits moves median −1.06 → +3.79, monotone, and ≥4 hits is 6/6 years. Whenever a score looks impressive at its top decile, check whether the top decile is just the names that already ran.

findings.title: The entire breakout alphabet measures at or below zero — systematically
findings.definition: BO/BX/BE = noise (confluence kill-list) · 3G (gap above all 3 fast EMAs) is the WORST breakout entry at +0.4%/3-6yr while the scoring engine ranked it HIGHEST (+12) · BB↑ negative (−1.55) · breakout was the worst of three entries in the Zanger decomposition · the '2nd entry on broken resistance' that every breakout infographic pushes is −6.18/win40.6/pf0.97 · RSI-50 and all 12 EMA-cross codes (P2/P3/P50/P55/P66/P89 + D mirror) are indistinguishable from baseline. The same formula that LOSES on broken-resistance PAYS on support-after-a-drop (+0.46/pf1.23, 6/6yr): the edge was never the geometry, it is BUYING ABSORBED WEAKNESS. Strength-chasing in retest clothing is still strength-chasing.

findings.title: The surviving edges are states you cannot screenshot
findings.definition: Sort the validated book by what it measures and the pattern is total: absorption (L34/L46 colour-split, engulf-absorption, Z-absorb, D+L1), capitulation (GEM1, washout, QZ-capit), compression (❄️CONSO, coil-floor, dwell), relative-strength integrity (🏆RS — the universal worst-year rescuer), cross-timeframe echo, path roughness (H). None of these is a shape; every one requires measurement over a window. That is a structural reason they survive: they cannot be eyeballed, therefore they cannot be crowded by eyeballs.

findings.title: When only the DAILY shows it, it fails — the daily is the crowded timeframe
findings.definition: The strongest single veto found: a 1D signal with ZERO 4H/1H/15M echo is negative in 0/6 years; requiring ≥1 lower-TF confirmation flips it positive. The 🕐 1H dual-reclaim gate is the second universal booster after volume-event: 52 of 63 board setups improve, median Δ+1.34, and it survives the period-matched control. Mechanism to hold onto: everyone reads the daily chart, so the daily alone is the picture the crowd already has. Information lives one timeframe below where the crowd is looking.

findings.title: Knowing when NOT to trade is worth more than another signal
findings.definition: Measured suppressors, each larger than most edges: Dec-Mar kills ALL 14 setups (even in bull years; only Z11 and GEM1 tolerate it) · close<EMA200 with e9>e20>e50, the bear-market rally, costs every setup −1 to −3.3 and is era-independent · no intraday volume EVENT drops EVERY one of the 29 TZ/L codes by 4-8 points · NOT-CONSO (expansion state) is −3.67/win43.6 · H>0.65 is −2.37. Compare to a GOOD edge at +2 to +5. The asymmetry means the first question is never 'what fires?' but 'is this a state where anything works?'

findings.title: Take the entry the crowd finds uncomfortable — every time it is measured, it wins
findings.definition: Pullback beats strength-chase universally (+0.7 to +1.9pp, 6/6yr; chasing strength LOSES). Buy the LOW of the confluence box, not the breakout of it. Wyckoff: buy the SHAKEOUT (spring +1.06/6yr, gap variant +2.87), never the breakout. Zone-retest: buy the 5th+ test of a support that HOLDS — a level everyone has written off. Capitulation bounce: buy the SMALL T1 inside a panic, not the big reversal bar. The common shape is that the profitable entry is the one that looks like it is failing at the moment you take it.

findings.title: A pattern that is beautiful on one chart is a story, not an edge
findings.definition: RKLB pullback-EMA20 and breakout looked superb on the name and measured ≈0 universe-wide; dormancy did not rescue it. The RSI-50 cross shows the same asymmetry on single names and nothing in aggregate. The 'smooth fingerprint' that seemed to select big P55 growth winners was pure survivor bias. Rule: never accept an idea whose evidence is a chart you were shown. Re-derive it across the universe, split by price bucket, and read the WORST year.

findings.title: 🌀 Rough-path H<0.45 — measured, NOT built (failed DSR)
findings.definition: Trailing-60-bar Hurst below 0.45 improved 9 of 10 base setups (D+L1 +1.11Δ · Washout +0.90Δ · L43-TRIPLE +0.69Δ · RTB-Base +0.68Δ at 6/6 and worst +0.6 · Atomic +0.62Δ · G3-Abs +0.61Δ), and its mirror H>0.55 destroys momentum setups (L43 −2.82, D+L1 −1.98, G3-Abs −1.85). RTB-Base🌀ROUGH was BUILT on the TIER-1 bar and REMOVED the same day: DSR 0.010 against a 0.6 bar — sr 0.1202 vs sr* 0.1436 over 30 honest trials (10 setups × 2 directions + 5 H60 bands + 5 H40 bands). Its Sharpe was the HIGHEST of the three gates measured that day and still BELOW what picking the best of 30 produces by chance. Every eyeball criterion passed — 6/6 years, worst +0.5, pf 1.31→1.44, win 51.8→53.5. THE LESSON: TIER-1 (positive worst year + 6/6) is necessary and NOT sufficient; it says nothing about how many variants you searched. Run DSR before calling anything built. The LAW is unaffected — a monotone ladder over five bands on four metrics, replicated on a second window, is not a max-pick, so the selection critique does not touch it. Wyckoff Spring is the one setup preferring SMOOTH (+0.11→+1.58 at H>0.55).

findings.title: ❄️ Compression gate (sig_conso)
findings.definition: The combo_engine tight gate: 6-bar range≤3.5% OR ATR%≤3.0 OR |ema9−ema20|/ema20≤2.0. Fires on 69% of bars, so it is a REGIME and its own median is zero (+0.03) — what carries is its ABSENCE: NOT-CONSO is −3.67/win 43.6. Helped 8 of 11 base setups (median Δ+0.31) and the split is mechanical: it helps every absorption/capitulation setup and HURTS the three that require range EXPANSION by their own definition (Engulf-Abs −1.32, L43-TRIPLE −0.44, G3-Abs −0.27). Built where it clears 6/6 years with a positive worst year: Washout🧊 (−0.53→+1.54, worst −2.2→+0.7) and RTB-Base🧊 (+0.72→+1.09, worst −0.1→+0.4).

findings.title: BB↑ (Bollinger breakout) = NEGATIVE, not merely empty
findings.definition: close>BB_upper(20,2) & volume crossing 1.5× & RSI>55. Path-sim 6yr $21-377: median −1.55 / win 46.1 / pf 1.05 against a −0.63 baseline — 0.92pp WORSE — and the NOT-BB↑ half is −0.56. It held the largest single bonus in ultra_score (+15) and a +2 in turbo_engine; both removed 2026-07-29. A textbook strength-chase breakout, which is exactly the sign 'fade strength' predicts.

findings.title: SVS (volume expansion on a green bar) = empty
findings.definition: vol/avg20 crossing 1.4× with close>open. −0.69 vs a −0.63 baseline, NOT-SVS −0.53: zero content. Carried +8 in ultra_score and +5 in prebreak_v3, both removed. It is the BREAKOUT side of the context-dependent volume law, where volume does not pay.

findings.title: UM (established up-move) = the worst of its family, and it POISONS setups
findings.definition: ema9>ema20>ema50 & ROC(40)≥8% & max-vol(40)>1.4×. −1.40 / win 46.5 / 3-6yr, 0.77pp below baseline while NOT-UM is −0.29. As a gate it destroys validated setups: D+L1 −2.66, QZ-Capit −2.51. It is the literal definition of 'the trend is already running', and that is the state to avoid, not to join.

findings.title: SETUP tokens A / SM / N / MX = one mask wearing four labels
findings.definition: SM −0.44 · MX −0.46 · A −0.48 · N −0.48 against a −0.63 baseline — a 0.04pp spread across four supposedly different signals, and every complement lands in the same place (NOT-A −0.54, NOT-SM −0.55, NOT-N −0.54, NOT-MX −0.55): presence vs absence is worth 0.08pp. Stacking adds nothing (all four −0.39) and +🏆RS lifts all four to the SAME number (+0.29/+0.33/+0.31/+0.31). They share preTurnStructure and identical structure gates. NOTE the meta-lesson: SM is the only absorption-flavoured one and the prior said it would win — it did not. 'It contains the right idea' does not survive measurement.

findings.title: Compare a filter to its COMPLEMENT, never to the baseline
findings.definition: A filter that keeps 69% of the population can beat the whole population for trivial reasons. CONSO looked like a weak positive (+0.03 vs −0.63) until it was compared to NOT-CONSO (−3.67) — which is what made it credible AND reframed it from signal to suppressor. Any filter retaining more than ~25% of bars must be scored against its own complement.

findings.title: Prove a new variable is not an old one renamed
findings.definition: Before believing a new state variable, correlate it with the ones already in the book and re-test it INSIDE their buckets. H passed: corr(H, ATR%) = −0.008 and the H spread survives within every ATR%% tercile, so it is genuinely orthogonal to volatility. Had it only paid ACROSS vol buckets it would have been volatility with a Greek letter.

findings.title: Audit scoring weights largest-first
findings.definition: Both backwards weights found so far were large and unmeasured: CCI0R (+5 doubled in HARD_BEAR) and BB↑ (+15, the single biggest bonus in ultra_score). Sort every scoring engine by weight magnitude and measure from the top down; the ranking of unmeasured confidence is a ranking of risk.

findings.title: A study returning zero fires everywhere is a plumbing bug
findings.definition: edge_replay._pull's OUTER projection is an explicit column list — the SELECT * is only in the inner CTE. A new DB column that is not added there arrives silently as all-False, and every variant in the study returns 0 or an identical number. If every arm of an experiment agrees exactly, suspect the data before the hypothesis.

findings.title: Rank by worst year, not by mean
findings.definition: The TIER-1 bar used for every gate built in this project is 5-6 positive years AND a positive worst year, on base setups only. It is what separated Washout🧊 and RTB-Base🧊 (both 6/6, worst +0.7/+0.4) from Spring +1.17Δ, QZ-Capit +0.61Δ and Zone-Retest +0.59Δ, which have larger or comparable lifts but still-negative worst years. A mean is a promise; a worst year is a survival test.

findings.title: TIER-1 is necessary, NOT sufficient — run DSR
findings.definition: A positive worst year plus 6/6 positive years says a variant is ROBUST ACROSS TIME. It says nothing about how many variants you searched to find it. RTB-Base🌀ROUGH cleared TIER-1 (6/6, worst +0.5, Δ+0.63, pf 1.31→1.44) with the HIGHEST raw Sharpe of its cohort — 0.1202 — and failed DSR at 0.010 because it came from 30 trials where sr* = 0.1436. The two CONSO gates, from 11 trials with sr* = 0.0943, passed at 0.944 and 0.891 on LOWER Sharpes. Count the trials HONESTLY: everything examined while choosing, not the survivors. Same evidence, opposite verdict, purely from search width.
